name: Validate Project Assignment Role
Create Timesheet From Task
script:
if doc.custom_assign_employee:

    # Get Task creation datetime
    task_created = frappe.utils.get_datetime(doc.creation)

    # Get only the creation date
    task_created_date = task_created.date()


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Find Timesheets belonging to this Employee
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    timesheets = frappe.db.get_all(
        "Timesheet",
        filters={
            "employee": doc.custom_assign_employee
        },
        fields=[
            "name",
            "creation"
        ],
        order_by="creation desc"
    )


    existing_timesheet = None


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Find Timesheet created on the same date
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    for ts in timesheets:

        timesheet_created = frappe.utils.get_datetime(
            ts.creation
        )

        timesheet_created_date = timesheet_created.date()


        if timesheet_created_date == task_created_date:

            existing_timesheet = ts.name
            break


    # ========================================================
    # EXISTING TIMESHEET FOUND
    # ========================================================

    if existing_timesheet:

        timesheet = frappe.get_doc(
            "Timesheet",
            existing_timesheet
        )


        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Check whether this Task is already in Timesheet
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        task_exists = False

        for row in timesheet.time_logs:

            if row.task == doc.name:

                task_exists = True
                break


        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Add Task if it is not already present
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        if not task_exists:

            time_log = timesheet.append(
                "time_logs",
                {}
            )


            # Activity Type
            if doc.custom_activity_type:

                time_log.activity_type = (
                    doc.custom_activity_type
                )


            # Project
            if doc.project:

                time_log.project = doc.project


            # Task
            time_log.task = doc.name


            # Description
            time_log.description = (
                "Task added automatically: " + doc.name
            )


            # IMPORTANT:
            # Do NOT set:
            #
            # from_time
            # to_time
            # hours


            timesheet.save(
                ignore_permissions=True
            )


            frappe.msgprint(
                "Task added to today's Timesheet: "
                + timesheet.name
            )


    # ========================================================
    # NO TIMESHEET FOUND
    # ========================================================

    else:

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Create new Timesheet
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        timesheet = frappe.new_doc(
            "Timesheet"
        )


        # Employee
        timesheet.employee = (
            doc.custom_assign_employee
        )


        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Add first Task
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        time_log = timesheet.append(
            "time_logs",
            {}
        )


        # Activity Type
        if doc.custom_activity_type:

            time_log.activity_type = (
                doc.custom_activity_type
            )


        # Project
        if doc.project:

            time_log.project = doc.project


        # Task
        time_log.task = doc.name


        # Description
        time_log.description = (
            "Task added automatically: " + doc.name
        )


        # IMPORTANT:
        # Do NOT set:
        #
        # from_time
        # to_time
        # hours


        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Create Timesheet
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        timesheet.insert(
            ignore_permissions=True
        )


        frappe.msgprint(
            "New Timesheet created: "
            + timesheet.name
        )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Employee Group Filter
# API Method:
# get_employee_groups_for_current_user
# ---------------------------------------------------------

current_user = frappe.session.user

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Find Employee linked to current ERPNext User
# ---------------------------------------------------------

employee = frappe.db.get_value(
    "Employee",
    {
        "user_id": current_user,
        "status": "Active"
    },
    "name"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# No Employee found
# ---------------------------------------------------------

if not employee:

    frappe.response["message"] = {
        "employee_groups": [],
        "group_employees": []
    }

else:

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # Find Employee Groups containing this Employee
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    groups = frappe.get_all(
        "Employee Group Table",
        filters={
            "employee": employee
        },
        fields=["parent"],
        limit_page_length=1000
    )

    employee_groups = list(
        set(
            row.parent
            for row in groups
            if row.parent
        )
    )

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # Selected Employee Group
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    selected_group = frappe.form_dict.get("employee_group")

    group_employees = []

    if selected_group:

        # -------------------------------------------------
        # Make sure selected group belongs to current user
        # -------------------------------------------------

        if selected_group in employee_groups:

            rows = frappe.get_all(
                "Employee Group Table",
                filters={
                    "parent": selected_group
                },
                fields=["employee"],
                limit_page_length=1000
            )

            group_employees = list(
                set(
                    row.employee
                    for row in rows
                    if row.employee
                )
            )

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # Return result
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    frappe.response["message"] = {
        "employee_groups": employee_groups,
        "group_employees": group_employees
    }
